This tournament will be played in September. Schedule your own games! Teams will be decided by a draft prior to the tournament. == Format == * '''General Information''' ** 10 min rounds ** 2on2 * '''Group stage, BO5:''' ** '''Maps:''' The procedure is "pick (team 1) - pick (team 2) - pick (team 2) - pick (team 1) - play". ** The team that wins "/cmd rnd team1 team2" picks first. ** Team colors will be randomized for each round. ** The first team to win 3 maps wins. ** Standings determined by won games, followed by won rounds followed by head-to-head meeting. * '''Grand Final, BO5:''' ** The top 2 teams play a Grand Final ** '''Maps:''' The procedure is "pick (team 1) - pick (team 2) - pick (team 2) - pick (team 1) - play". ** The team that wins "/cmd rnd team1 team2" picks first. ** Team colors will be randomized for each round. ** The first team to win 3 All info in [https://discord.gg/uaMKvnDpwz CTF Discord]. *'''How to get started with CTF''' ** Bind the hook with +fire 22 , or impulse 22 (bind q +fire 22) for example. ** Bind tossrune, to throw away your current rune: (bind r tossrune) for example. ** Practice your hook skills and config on a KTX-server. For example: connect london.badplace.eu:28503, in the console, type: ctf, then type: practice. ** The map [[Mammoth]] by {{player|alice|flag=se}} and QWRCTF1 by Infiniti are at the moment only available on de.aye.wtf:27501. == Trailer == {{#ev:youtube|O_7mRtqnjL4|580}} __NOTOC__
